Rule: A registered study or programme does not establish recruitment, completion, publication, safety, effectiveness, authorization, or ethical adequacy.
A publication does not establish trial-wide validation, primary-endpoint success, current configuration equivalence, or generalizability.
Signal detection or classification does not establish functional benefit, independent use, or clinical outcome.
A demonstration does not establish prespecified performance, assistance burden, longitudinal reliability, or safety.
Fluent or plausible output does not establish accurate neural decoding or access to intended, private, or unspoken mental content.
Performance or safety from one participant does not transfer automatically to another participant or population.
Evidence from one hardware, firmware, software, model, calibration, or support configuration does not automatically transfer to another.
Laboratory, clinic, supervised, or prompted performance does not establish home, autonomous, workplace, educational, or consumer performance.
Consent does not by itself establish legality, proportionality, voluntariness, scientific validity, or freedom from structural coercion.
A documented or configured security control does not establish operating effectiveness without executed evidence.
Absence of a public adverse-event report does not establish absence of harm.
Commercial availability, funding, procurement, or regulatory interaction does not establish ethical acceptability or conformance.
A supported claim, legal authorization, or regulatory decision does not establish system conformance unless a separate conformance decision has been made by the competent assurance authority.
Absence of public evidence does not establish conformity, nonconformity, or absence of a privately held record.
Enrollment, setup, analysis, completer, preference, exposure, and postmarket denominators may not be substituted for one another.
Longitudinal performance, continued use, or active channels do not establish implant safety, adverse-event absence, or trial-wide safety.
Researcher-free operation does not establish care-partner, maintenance, infrastructure, transport, or sponsor independence.
Reproduction of figures or analyses does not establish reproduction of endpoints, models, online systems, or clinical workflows.
Consultation, co-design, satisfaction, or continued participation does not establish voting, veto, evidence-use control, dissent authority, or remedy.
